purpose: Observe scheduler running/waiting/wakeup/kernel/syscall timeline around original native child startups; not another generic stack sample. Whole-system context may contain other processes. No compiler attribution guaranteed.
collection_scope: One7second System Trace launched against an owned wrapper and unchanged original test. Default template includes scheduling,systemcalls,VM,file activity,thermal/time-profile data. size_limit_caveat: Output stop threshold checked every100ms; transient overshoot and Instruments-managed cache outside private output cannot be strictly byte-capped by this script.
retention: Raw trace mode0700 private workspace only, no commit/upload; inspect schema and export only exact owned test and explicitly approved syspolicyd/XprotectService numeric timelines; discard other rows. If safe export unavailable,unknown and delete after owned cleanup audit. Any other-process retained attribution requires new scope.
authentication: Instruments/macOS may request system authorization. No --no-prompt,password capture,policy bypass or persistent privileged service. Missing authentication ends bounded attempt; no retry automatically.
original_contract: Normal-source original test unchanged1000ms8x16/native/cwd/env/group/stdout/stderr/overflow/cancel. Trace overhead is diagnostic perturbation; success is not repair. No warmup/budget renewal/fixture substitution.
